# m1ddc diagnostic backend

Unmodified sources/headers from https://github.com/waydabber/m1ddc
at commit `04d949794102eb8df01ad3681afff6464a3eede2` (MIT; see LICENSE).
Built as a signed helper by build-app.sh. The experimental UI restricts access
to exactly one locally discovered AOC U27B3CF and configured input codes. No shell interpolation is used.
